routes.title: Would opening the window earlier help?
routes.goal: Start with a decision worth answering; derive why testing explanations and testing the decision need different evidence.
routes.earned_outcome: Understand why Crucis must check what a causal-discovery answer means and what its evidence supports.
routes.visual_purpose: One apartment scene develops through the approved five opening stages.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: Crucis research home
routes.goal: Derive the need for Crucis from the apartment decision, then expose five connected audit questions, evidence boundaries, open choices and the study rationale in one page.
routes.earned_outcome: Explain the project, inspect a territory, identify decisive next work, and distinguish coverage from statistical study size.
routes.visual_purpose: A short developing apartment scene, five linked duties, inline selectable landscape, separate instrument/study tracks and a sizing path. Region geometry is schematic.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: Follow a statement to its evidence
routes.goal: Explain the public evidence view before exposing exact source bindings and derivations.
routes.earned_outcome: Know what the linked record establishes, what access permits and what remains independently unreproduced.
routes.visual_purpose: Trace a visible sentence to the exact version, source excerpt and bounded interpretation.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What changed, and why?
routes.goal: Preserve dated assessment editions and the reason an interpretation changed.
reader_prerequisites: Current and historical assessments can differ without rewriting the old evidence.
routes.earned_outcome: Tell an earlier valid claim from a stale present use; inspect the change without invented session attribution.
routes.visual_purpose: Before/after record with retained predecessor and affected-dependency paths.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: Where could a useful challenge change our direction?
routes.goal: Turn a genuine unresolved choice into a focused review entry with alternatives and decisive evidence.
reader_prerequisites: Prepared expectations and qualification results are different; a session does not establish correctness.
routes.earned_outcome: See what a TA or specialist could add beyond already completed source reading or an ordinary engineering check.
routes.visual_purpose: Question-to-alternatives-to-decisive-work paths, not a contact funnel or generic meeting agenda.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: How does new work change the record?
routes.goal: Show how private notes, proposed findings, accepted scientific changes and public editions remain distinct.
routes.earned_outcome: Understand one-note refresh, no-finding, disagreement, exposure, source corrections and publication approval without equating activity to progress.
routes.visual_purpose: An event can propose an evidence/argument change; only accepted, scoped changes affect a public edition.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What actually happened during the run?
routes.goal: Separate intended work, authorized effects, issued requests, observed native results, capture and settled outcomes.
reader_prerequisites: A missing graph is different from a captured graph containing no arrows.
routes.earned_outcome: Know why timeout, cancellation request, capture recovery and a fresh native attempt need different dispositions.
routes.visual_purpose: One run timeline with separate request, native-return and capture markers; unknown spans stay unknown.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What makes an answer key usable?
routes.goal: Derive why the source must license this exact question, variable scope and case edition.
reader_prerequisites: The apartment scene provides named quantities and proposed arrows.
routes.earned_outcome: Distinguish a table of observations from source rules and a covered reference answer.
routes.visual_purpose: Same apartment values alongside two possible causal explanations.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What would rule an explanation out?
routes.goal: Use a bounded exercise to derive what observations and controlled changes do and do not distinguish.
reader_prerequisites: A source can leave more than one allowed diagram.
routes.earned_outcome: Explain exactly which assumption or controlled record excludes an orientation; do not infer direction from a table alone.
routes.visual_purpose: Select directions in a three/four-node exercise, then reveal a worked source-specific derivation.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: Where does the answer key stop helping?
routes.goal: Show which reference questions have an engineering design, which await qualification, and which require scientific judgment.
reader_prerequisites: A derived reference conclusion holds within its declared class and source scope.
routes.earned_outcome: Identify model fidelity, allowed-class and transfer questions without reopening solved version-binding work.
routes.visual_purpose: A declared class boundary with one counterexample crossing it.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: Which answer did we check?
routes.goal: Follow one retained output through occurrence, subject, field and cutoff selection.
reader_prerequisites: One method can produce more than one diagram during a single attempt.
routes.earned_outcome: See why same attempt or intact bytes do not establish the requested final product.
routes.visual_purpose: Two intact recorded fields; the selected one remains visibly attached to its occurrence.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What does this answer actually mean?
routes.goal: Derive representation and variable correspondence before assigning causal commitments.
reader_prerequisites: The selected object is fixed independently of how well it scores.
routes.earned_outcome: Distinguish direct edge, indirect route, graph candidate and probability product; preserve default/tie attribution.
routes.visual_purpose: A matrix cell becomes a named relation; a wire and a multi-step route remain separate.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: When is there no answer to judge?
routes.goal: Separate partial/absent/unavailable evidence, abstention and semantic inapplicability at the intended cutoff.
reader_prerequisites: Knowing reference truth does not tell us what the method returned.
routes.earned_outcome: Choose the appropriate held or inapplicable disposition without inventing a negative answer or fresh occurrence.
routes.visual_purpose: Captured empty graph, missing capture and probability output remain different products.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What makes a comparison fair?
routes.goal: Start from the decision a comparison should inform; align task, product, information and native claim.
reader_prerequisites: Graphs and probability products need not express the same answer.
routes.earned_outcome: Explain why a common metric or equal timer does not create the same scientific task.
routes.visual_purpose: Paired question/information/product columns make a mismatch visible before scoring.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What counts as a useful answer?
routes.goal: Derive source accuracy, evidence support, delivery and omission/failure rules for an applicable product.
reader_prerequisites: The intended comparison question and native product are fixed.
routes.earned_outcome: Keep wrong source answer, unsupported stronger conclusion, abstention and unavailable evidence distinct.
routes.visual_purpose: Same proposed arrow under different evidence; outcome labels change only where their deciding premise changes.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What can these cases tell us?
routes.goal: Bind eligible case mixture, weights, independent units, failure costs and uncertainty to the intended claim.
reader_prerequisites: A case-level outcome is defined only for compatible native/reference questions.
routes.earned_outcome: Explain why repeated calls are not independent worlds; retain missing slots and distinguish logical bounds from sampling uncertainty.
routes.visual_purpose: Weighted case blocks retain blanks and shared-source dependence rather than disappearing from the frame.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: Can a reader retrace the finding?
routes.goal: Reconstruct one bounded statement from the selected answer, reference, calculation and consumed inputs.
reader_prerequisites: Native meaning and the intended comparison are separate prerequisites.
routes.earned_outcome: Rebuild the narrow result and reject a stronger sentence that its evidence does not support.
routes.visual_purpose: A sentence unfolds into source and result records with an actual joined-path gap visible.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What changes after a correction?
routes.goal: Preserve the old record while reopening affected conclusions and justifying unaffected continuation.
reader_prerequisites: A correct calculation does not guarantee a faithful report.
routes.earned_outcome: Separate suggested fix, implemented change and accepted retest; preserve exposure, disagreement and reasons.
routes.visual_purpose: Changed premise highlights affected descendants; unchanged branches require explicit dependency justification.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What can someone else independently check?
routes.goal: Distinguish a readable public explanation, public source access and reproducible original execution.
reader_prerequisites: Traceability requires access to the decisive material, not just a hash.
routes.earned_outcome: Understand privacy/access limits without treating a private binding as public reproducibility.
routes.visual_purpose: Public evidence closure beside withheld raw material with the resulting limit named.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: Can Crucis get the important cases right?
routes.goal: Use positive, error, ambiguity, wrong-field, unavailable and inapplicable cases to test different audit obligations.
reader_prerequisites: A prepared expected outcome differs from an observed auditor result.
routes.earned_outcome: Know why a checker that withholds everything fails the supported-positive duty, and why component passes do not certify a whole path.
routes.visual_purpose: Contrasting cases keep native answer, independent reference and expected auditor action aligned.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What do the checks actually cover?
routes.goal: Define independently adjudicable obligations, explicit component preconditions and whole-path duties.
reader_prerequisites: Each control has a scope; one passing run cannot validate unrelated behavior.
routes.earned_outcome: Read a frozen eligible denominator without mistaking inventory groups or passed tests for all-auditor correctness.
routes.visual_purpose: Obligation/case matrix includes unrun and reopened cells; no universal completion percentage.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

routes.title: What happens when the next system is different?
routes.goal: Qualify new native meanings, model classes, interfaces and deployment assumptions before transferring assurance.
reader_prerequisites: Scope and dependencies limit what prior evidence can establish.
routes.earned_outcome: Identify genuine extension research, reused qualified obligations and new composition duties without promising future-proof completeness.
routes.visual_purpose: Existing bounded territory beside an unqualified extension, with precise dependency crossings.
routes.status: Editorial home included in this edition; no scientific qualification credit follows from this mapping.

capability_mapping.title: Variables, native forms and semantic profiles
capability_mapping.operation: Interpret supported native families, coordinates, explicit mappings and profile requirements.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Encoding/DAG/measure checks are scoped; causal meaning and complete latent/relational support do not follow from preservation.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Tasks, source-scoped cases and references
capability_mapping.operation: Bind task, case revision, reference, information condition and native request.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: S2 metadata completion is not scientific truth, native fulfillment or authority.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Comparison, population and adaptive design
capability_mapping.operation: Declare units, membership, selection, matching, transformations, repetitions and amendments.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Recorded labels and completed attempts do not establish independent samples or fair causal comparisons.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Admission, issue and owner/resource accounting
capability_mapping.operation: Bind actual live owners, policy, resource reservations and intended dispatch effects.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Metadata permission and successful transport do not establish native effect or universal monetary/isolation guarantees.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Observation, interaction and recovery
capability_mapping.operation: Collect evidence, observe interactions, reconcile uncertain dispatch and distinguish restart, stop and collection closure.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Acknowledgment is not termination; restored model state is not exact trajectory restoration.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Staging, journals and immutable publication
capability_mapping.operation: Retain intent before effect, stage bounded inputs, publish exact audience/dependency closures and observe current selection.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Cooperative local custody is not hostile-process isolation, distributed transactionality or external authentication.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Scoped proposition measurement
capability_mapping.operation: Select a native/reference proposition and judge only covered, interpretable keys. The declared_scope/declared_assessment branch separately qualifies native meaning, reference truth/warrant and signed direct-claim assessment.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Partial/open/closed/missing/abstaining states retain distinct masks; reference qualification remains a separate premise. Finite BIF/SCM arithmetic does not establish source authenticity, controlled-model adoption, physical truth or native eligibility; no default scientific oracle is installed.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Ordering and binary point questions
capability_mapping.operation: Assess strict sequences and named binary-event losses under qualified task/reference semantics.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Necessary-only constraints and event/cutoff identity matter; field reliability is not a six-permutation result.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Aggregation, bounds, posterior and reproduction
capability_mapping.operation: Compute named paired quantities, intended-frame enclosures, finite conditional posterior and exact reproduction comparisons.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Outer ranges are not sampling intervals; conditional finite models are not model adequacy; numerical agreement is not scientific replication.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Rules, findings, registration and history
capability_mapping.operation: Bind rule/criterion, observe decision work, assess temporal registration and preserve corrections.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Source attribution is not new evidence; fixture rule semantics do not qualify a new estimator or threshold rationale.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Reporting, certificates, disclosure and currentness
capability_mapping.operation: Render controlled views, check fidelity/lineage, replay within authority and retain outward/current-selection distinctions.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Deterministic JSON/Markdown controls do not cover every format or establish issuer authentication or public release permission.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Independent auditor-validation workflow
capability_mapping.operation: Plan opportunities, qualify independent expectations, compare actual candidate work and preserve denominators/handoffs.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Initial implemented roster is the legacy K10/K12 fixed grid plus controlled reporting; it does not certify all new native/question families.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Continuous scientific source and direct-claim reference
capability_mapping.operation: Bind original real variables and declared model class, raw-coordinate premises, reference mathematics and target correspondence.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Fixed source/fork/triangle arguments are conditional; normalization capture is not a transformation proof or a universal reference solver.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Numerical realization, checking and cohort supply
capability_mapping.operation: Bind numerical observation, pinned replay, separate checker, material emission and intended/released/assessable supply.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Replay trusts declared library evidence; repeated checks and copies are not new draws, ideal iid guarantees or independent families.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: System-specific native adapters
capability_mapping.operation: Expose declared recorded/replay/live modes, native stage/object interpretations and system-specific control boundaries.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Named adapters and prepared ports are not proof of supported live execution or scientific eligibility for a new case.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Legacy graph, transformation and finding path
capability_mapping.operation: Preserve the distinct legacy audit path, graph conventions, controls, metrics and frozen rule meanings.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Historical recomputation stays at its original population, tolerance and claim scope; opt-in lifecycle support is not inherited automatically.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Recorded stages, reruns and legacy reports
capability_mapping.operation: Reconstruct recorded stage lineage, compare reruns and verify legacy report/certificate content at stated boundaries.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: A reconstructed stage or matching number does not authenticate original native occurrence, prove observation neutrality or replicate science.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Study workers, timing and native qualification controls
capability_mapping.operation: Prepare bounded Q1 study and native qualification mechanics: assignments/commands in q1_pilot, pinned workers/observers in systems, durable stage/owner/fit/window/storage controls in execution.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Current continuous window held before native dispatch; corrected offline controls do not supply successful corrected execution or paid efficacy.
capability_mapping.limit_note: This is retained 16 November source-account scope, not a current software-status verdict.

capability_mapping.title: Shared primitives, declarations and distribution
capability_mapping.operation: Account for shared helpers, serialization/dependency assumptions, entry points, specimen builders, package and build boundaries. The dev gate is development/test tooling, separate from Q1 study execution and scientific certificates.
capability_mapping.inherited_evidence_limit: Static declarations and passing an old distribution check do not qualify every installed environment or new combination. Workbench architecture remains design guidance only, not Crucis package evidence.

coverage_display_policy.reason: Reader routes, capability groups, artifacts and interface mappings are not independently adjudicable leaves. Frozen per-assessment eligible obligations must be derived and independently decided before displaying a scoped score.
coverage_display_policy.allowed_count: The finite count of pages, mapped inventory groups or individually dispositioned obligations may be shown as that exact inventory count, never as proof of scientific adequacy.

scope_interpretation.bounded: All 52 prior HTML artifacts receive a disposition. All 7 retained promises,10families,20capabilities and4composition categories have reader-route homes.
scope_interpretation.not_claimed: Navigation coverage is not independently adjudicable obligation completion, executable support, scientific correctness or an exhausted future problem space.
scope_interpretation.unknown_unknowns: Independent omission challenge, counterexample search and new-profile admission can discover new duties; preserve a versioned change disposition.
scope_interpretation.new_discovery_policy: Necessary in-scope premise -> revise affected route/dependencies. Bounded open choice -> show explicit alternatives and decisive work. Future work -> justify exclusion; never keep a stronger claim whose premise was deferred.

excluded_from_release: Canonical S7 implementations or study-rule changes
New native/provider runs or paid studies
Public attribution of private TA/expert activity
Universal future-system correctness score or 100-percent unknown-space claim
Raw private campaign/evidence stores, contact details or sealed seeds
required_data_views: Machine-readable public release data derived from approved evidence projection
Versioned public-history summary without private attribution
Private-only release inventory and source-reconciliation receipts
completion_gate: Every frozen route is implemented and checked; no known consequential reader leap or unqualified stronger status claim; public-source/access limits visible; exact final build and diff bound to checks. Genuine open research can remain.
